engine.notes: Vendored copy under tools/mlx-vlm-spike/vendor/mlx-swift-lm, carrying vendor/pr384.diff (Gemma 4 E-series shared-KV loading) and vendor/multi-image-fix.diff. A model entry is only valid against this engine revision — a Hub re-conversion can break an older engine, so revisions are pinned on both sides. See docs/ai/phase0-findings.md. Entries whose own `engine` is not `mlx` don't run on it at all and ignore this block.
engine.notesOnBuiltIns: A built-in entry (engine other than "mlx") has no repo, no revision and no download: it is a system framework the app can call today. It still carries an id and a name because it is chosen the same way an installed model is.

models.name: Apple Vision
models.summary: Apple's built-in scene and object classifier. Instant, and nothing to download. It tags a capture but doesn't write a name — keep a language model for titles.

models.name: Gemma 4 E2B
models.summary: Google's small multimodal model. Names and tags a capture in about a second once loaded.
